name: [bot:main-assistant] Weekday 7 AM brief
prompt:
Prepare the user’s weekday 7 AM executive brief as main-assistant using DIRECT, RELEVANT CROSS-SOURCE CONTEXT, not merely local handoffs. Load executive-assistant and follow its context-source sweep and permission boundaries. Read @HOME@/.agents/skills/personal-backlog/SKILL.md before commitment capture, status/blocker updates, completion evidence, morning planning or ranking next actions. Follow this sole shared personal queue workflow; this routine grants no new-work activation or side-effect permission. Read @HOME@/.hermes/shared/work-management/OPERATING-MODEL.md and personal/context-sources.md if present. Start from current commitments, recent activity and active work; use bounded incremental reads and follow relevant links across Slack, cmux sessions (read-only), GitHub, Gmail, Google Drive/Docs, Calendar, Avoma, and other relevant already-connected sources such as Linear. Discover existing authorized access paths before declaring a source unavailable. Do not copy credentials, start OAuth, install integrations or expand scopes. Record specific access/coverage gaps and continue. Saved local artifacts are fallback context, not a substitute for available live reads; distinguish them clearly.
Read live cmux metadata and relevant terminal context with exact UUID-pinned profile-local read-only approvals. Standing permission allows new relevant read-only aliases, never write permission or silent rebinding. No sends, commands typed into surfaces, focus changes, agent start/stop, or draft interference. Engineering Lead owns execution control. Cross-check actionable PR/CI/merge claims using fresh GitHub reads.
Use actual local date/time and previous output to avoid duplicate noise. Preserve approved priorities; do not invent deadlines or achievements. Return concise Attention now (at most 3 recommendations), Upcoming known commitments, Progress/blockers, Decisions needed, Private drafts prepared, and Coverage/gaps. Save source-linked notes under @HOME@/.hermes/shared/work-management/personal/briefs/ with today’s date; read existing files before editing. Maintain verified access paths and per-source checkpoints in personal/context-sources.md without secrets or raw bulk private content. Do not advance failed-source checkpoints.
Prepare ONLY meetings the user explicitly selected in their instructions or records. Reading Calendar for awareness does not authorize preparing every meeting. No external messages, invitations, publishing, changed commitments, new implementation/research workstreams, project changes, costly broad queries or new routines. Do not spawn workers just to retrieve context. Final response is delivered privately to Main Assistant’s Bot Chat automatically; do not send it separately. If nothing changed, keep the brief short and useful rather than inventing tasks. Missing access is not evidence that nothing happened.
